description: The definitions both directions of version 1 use: the forms of values, a lease, and a message's refusal.

message_id.description: A message's own id, given by its sender, unique among what that sender sends on its enrolment, and kept on a resend.

id.description: An id the control plane gave: an offer's, an act's, a command's, an inbox's or a terminal's. The runner never reads into it.

time.description: A time of the runner's or the control plane's: RFC 3339 in UTC to the second.

unsigned_integer.description: An integer from 0 that JavaScript reads exactly.

signed_integer.description: An integer that may be negative, within what JavaScript reads exactly.

lease_number.description: A lease's number, which the control plane moves when it gives the work again.

lease.description: A lease the control plane gives with a launch or a command.

expires.description: When the lease runs out unless a report renews it, or null where the control plane never moves the work.

commit.description: A commit, by its id in lowercase hex.

digest.description: sha256: and the hex of a file's bytes' digest, as an inbox's brief is carried.

bytes.description: Bytes in base64url without padding: a key, a signature, a certificate or a sealed frame.

message_refused.description: Either end's answer to a message that failed its check: the message, by its id, with words. Nothing else is done with it.
